findings.text: 整体：首访后14天口径下，费用增加1357.01，收入增加42.53。收入变化率低于费用变化率。这只是观测比较。

checkedExplanations: 已检查整体指标与比较时期。
limitations: 金额币种与时区未注明，沿用原始时间与样例金额单位
没有广告曝光、点击、预算、素材或真实广告增量
没有商品、结账步骤、退款或利润
费用只有渠道和日期粒度；无法计算设备或国家广告费用
订单没有 session ID；渠道、设备、国家使用首次观测访问归属
organic 未提供费用，费用缺失不补零
nextSteps: 可继续调整渠道、日期、指标或观察窗口核查；因果判断需要额外实验或触点数据。

sql:
WITH population AS (SELECT u.* FROM storewhy.profiles u  WHERE u.channel <> 'organic' AND u.first_seen >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND u.first_seen < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP)),
per_user AS (SELECT u.user_id,u.first_seen,'__all' AS segment,COUNT(p.purchase_id) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index>1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS repeat_amount,MIN(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN (unix_timestamp(p.purchased_at)-unix_timestamp(u.first_seen))/3600.0 ELSE NULL END) AS first_hours FROM population u LEFT JOIN storewhy.purchase_facts p ON p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.purchased_at >= u.first_seen AND p.purchased_at < u.first_seen + INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY u.user_id,u.first_seen),
user_agg AS (SELECT segment,COUNT(*) AS n_users,SUM(CASE WHEN first_seen >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND first_seen < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_new,SUM(CASE WHEN n_purchases>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_payers,SUM(CASE WHEN n_purchases>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_repeat_payers,SUM(n_purchases) AS n_purchases,SUM(revenue_amount) AS revenue_amount,SUM(first_amount) AS first_amount,SUM(repeat_amount) AS repeat_amount,AVG(first_hours) AS first_hours FROM per_user GROUP BY segment),
session_agg AS (SELECT '__all' AS segment,COUNT(*) AS n_sessions FROM population u JOIN storewhy.visits v ON u.user_id=v.user_id AND v.started_at >= u.first_seen AND v.started_at < u.first_seen + INTERVAL '14' DAY ),
cost_agg AS (SELECT '__all' AS segment,SUM(c.amount) AS spend_amount FROM storewhy.costs c WHERE c.cost_date >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS DATE) AND c.cost_date < CAST('2019-07-01' AS DATE) ),
keys AS (SELECT segment FROM user_agg UNION SELECT segment FROM session_agg UNION SELECT segment FROM cost_agg) SELECT k.segment,COALESCE(u.n_users,0) AS n_users,COALESCE(u.n_new,0) AS n_new,COALESCE(u.n_payers,0) AS n_payers,COALESCE(u.n_repeat_payers,0) AS n_repeat_payers,COALESCE(u.n_purchases,0) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(u.revenue_amount,0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(u.first_amount,0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(u.repeat_amount,0) AS repeat_amount,u.first_hours,COALESCE(s.n_sessions,0) AS n_sessions,c.spend_amount FROM keys k LEFT JOIN user_agg u ON k.segment=u.segment LEFT JOIN session_agg s ON k.segment=s.segment LEFT JOIN cost_agg c ON k.segment=c.segment ORDER BY k.segment LIMIT 201

cost_agg AS (SELECT '__all' AS segment,SUM(c.amount) AS spend_amount FROM storewhy.costs c WHERE c.cost_date >= CAST('2019-07-01' AS DATE) AND c.cost_date < CAST('2019-08-01' AS DATE) ),
keys AS (SELECT segment FROM user_agg UNION SELECT segment FROM session_agg UNION SELECT segment FROM cost_agg) SELECT k.segment,COALESCE(u.n_users,0) AS n_users,COALESCE(u.n_new,0) AS n_new,COALESCE(u.n_payers,0) AS n_payers,COALESCE(u.n_repeat_payers,0) AS n_repeat_payers,COALESCE(u.n_purchases,0) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(u.revenue_amount,0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(u.first_amount,0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(u.repeat_amount,0) AS repeat_amount,u.first_hours,COALESCE(s.n_sessions,0) AS n_sessions,c.spend_amount FROM keys k LEFT JOIN user_agg u ON k.segment=u.segment LEFT JOIN session_agg s ON k.segment=s.segment LEFT JOIN cost_agg c ON k.segment=c.segment ORDER BY k.segment LIMIT 201

definitions.spend: 所选渠道与日期内记录的费用，金额单位未注明；不按设备或国家分摊
definitions.new_users: 快照中首次访问发生在所选获客日期的用户数，不代表历史首次注册
definitions.payers: 时期或观察窗口内至少购买一次的不同用户数
definitions.revenue: 自然时期购买收入，或首访后 H 天收入；两种模式分别计算
definitions.payer_rate: 购买用户数 / 当前用户分母；批次模式分母为成熟首次出现用户
definitions.cost_per_new_user: 匹配获客日期的渠道费用 / 首次观测用户数；不是实验获客成本
definitions.revenue_to_spend: 观测归属口径下的收入 / 匹配日期渠道费用；不是利润或因果增量

notes: 归属采用首次观测渠道/设备/国家；这是观测比较，不是广告因果增量或利润。
时间为源数据原始时间，金额单位未标注。

per_user AS (SELECT u.user_id,u.first_seen,u.channel AS channel, '__all' AS segment,COUNT(p.purchase_id) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index>1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS repeat_amount,MIN(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN (unix_timestamp(p.purchased_at)-unix_timestamp(u.first_seen))/3600.0 ELSE NULL END) AS first_hours FROM population u LEFT JOIN storewhy.purchase_facts p ON p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.purchased_at >= u.first_seen AND p.purchased_at < u.first_seen + INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY u.user_id,u.first_seen,u.channel),
user_agg AS (SELECT channel, segment,COUNT(*) AS n_users,SUM(CASE WHEN first_seen >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND first_seen < CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_new,SUM(CASE WHEN n_purchases>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_payers,SUM(CASE WHEN n_purchases>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_repeat_payers,SUM(n_purchases) AS n_purchases,SUM(revenue_amount) AS revenue_amount,SUM(first_amount) AS first_amount,SUM(repeat_amount) AS repeat_amount,AVG(first_hours) AS first_hours FROM per_user GROUP BY channel, segment),
session_agg AS (SELECT u.channel AS channel, '__all' AS segment,COUNT(*) AS n_sessions FROM population u JOIN storewhy.visits v ON u.user_id=v.user_id AND v.started_at >= u.first_seen AND v.started_at < u.first_seen + INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY u.channel),
cost_agg AS (SELECT c.channel,'__all' AS segment,SUM(c.amount) AS spend_amount FROM storewhy.costs c WHERE c.cost_date >= CAST('2019-06-01' AS DATE) AND c.cost_date < CAST('2019-07-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel),
keys AS (SELECT channel, segment FROM user_agg UNION SELECT channel, segment FROM session_agg UNION SELECT channel, segment FROM cost_agg) SELECT k.channel, k.segment,COALESCE(u.n_users,0) AS n_users,COALESCE(u.n_new,0) AS n_new,COALESCE(u.n_payers,0) AS n_payers,COALESCE(u.n_repeat_payers,0) AS n_repeat_payers,COALESCE(u.n_purchases,0) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(u.revenue_amount,0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(u.first_amount,0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(u.repeat_amount,0) AS repeat_amount,u.first_hours,COALESCE(s.n_sessions,0) AS n_sessions,c.spend_amount FROM keys k LEFT JOIN user_agg u ON k.channel=u.channel AND k.segment=u.segment LEFT JOIN session_agg s ON k.channel=s.channel AND k.segment=s.segment LEFT JOIN cost_agg c ON k.channel=c.channel AND k.segment=c.segment ORDER BY k.channel, k.segment LIMIT 201

WITH population AS (SELECT u.* FROM storewhy.profiles u  WHERE u.channel <> 'organic' AND u.first_seen >= CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND u.first_seen < CAST('2019-08-01' AS TIMESTAMP)),
per_user AS (SELECT u.user_id,u.first_seen,u.channel AS channel, '__all' AS segment,COUNT(p.purchase_id) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index>1 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS repeat_amount,MIN(CASE WHEN p.purchase_index=1 THEN (unix_timestamp(p.purchased_at)-unix_timestamp(u.first_seen))/3600.0 ELSE NULL END) AS first_hours FROM population u LEFT JOIN storewhy.purchase_facts p ON p.user_id=u.user_id AND p.purchased_at >= u.first_seen AND p.purchased_at < u.first_seen + INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY u.user_id,u.first_seen,u.channel),
user_agg AS (SELECT channel, segment,COUNT(*) AS n_users,SUM(CASE WHEN first_seen >= CAST('2019-07-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND first_seen < CAST('2019-08-01' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_new,SUM(CASE WHEN n_purchases>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_payers,SUM(CASE WHEN n_purchases>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_repeat_payers,SUM(n_purchases) AS n_purchases,SUM(revenue_amount) AS revenue_amount,SUM(first_amount) AS first_amount,SUM(repeat_amount) AS repeat_amount,AVG(first_hours) AS first_hours FROM per_user GROUP BY channel, segment),
session_agg AS (SELECT u.channel AS channel, '__all' AS segment,COUNT(*) AS n_sessions FROM population u JOIN storewhy.visits v ON u.user_id=v.user_id AND v.started_at >= u.first_seen AND v.started_at < u.first_seen + INTERVAL '14' DAY GROUP BY u.channel),
cost_agg AS (SELECT c.channel,'__all' AS segment,SUM(c.amount) AS spend_amount FROM storewhy.costs c WHERE c.cost_date >= CAST('2019-07-01' AS DATE) AND c.cost_date < CAST('2019-08-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.channel),
keys AS (SELECT channel, segment FROM user_agg UNION SELECT channel, segment FROM session_agg UNION SELECT channel, segment FROM cost_agg) SELECT k.channel, k.segment,COALESCE(u.n_users,0) AS n_users,COALESCE(u.n_new,0) AS n_new,COALESCE(u.n_payers,0) AS n_payers,COALESCE(u.n_repeat_payers,0) AS n_repeat_payers,COALESCE(u.n_purchases,0) AS n_purchases,COALESCE(u.revenue_amount,0) AS revenue_amount,COALESCE(u.first_amount,0) AS first_amount,COALESCE(u.repeat_amount,0) AS repeat_amount,u.first_hours,COALESCE(s.n_sessions,0) AS n_sessions,c.spend_amount FROM keys k LEFT JOIN user_agg u ON k.channel=u.channel AND k.segment=u.segment LEFT JOIN session_agg s ON k.channel=s.channel AND k.segment=s.segment LEFT JOIN cost_agg c ON k.channel=c.channel AND k.segment=c.segment ORDER BY k.channel, k.segment LIMIT 201

definitions.spend: 所选渠道与日期内记录的费用，金额单位未注明；不按设备或国家分摊
definitions.new_users: 快照中首次访问发生在所选获客日期的用户数，不代表历史首次注册
definitions.payers: 时期或观察窗口内至少购买一次的不同用户数
definitions.revenue: 自然时期购买收入，或首访后 H 天收入；两种模式分别计算
definitions.payer_rate: 购买用户数 / 当前用户分母；批次模式分母为成熟首次出现用户
definitions.cost_per_new_user: 匹配获客日期的渠道费用 / 首次观测用户数；不是实验获客成本
definitions.revenue_to_spend: 观测归属口径下的收入 / 匹配日期渠道费用；不是利润或因果增量

notes: 归属采用首次观测渠道/设备/国家；这是观测比较，不是广告因果增量或利润。
时间为源数据原始时间，金额单位未标注。
